title: Reindeer (Rangifer tarandus) in Avon Valley
author: The Nature Box
changes: Reindeer (Rangifer tarandus) grunting three times at Avon Valley wildlife park, Bristol, UK; audio track of a video, taken from inside one continuous shot. Trimmed to 9.42–11.47 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.7 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. No high-pass: the excerpt has no measured low-frequency rumble.
